resources.string: Explore, discover, and listen to your favorite music with SoundCloud. EchoFlow makes it easy to find new tracks and enjoy your music wherever you go.
To keep your music playing without interruptions, we recommend disabling battery optimization for EchoFlow.
Allow notifications to control playback even when your phone is locked or while using other apps.
Sign in with SoundCloud to connect your account and access your music. You’ll be securely redirected to the SoundCloud website to complete authentication.
